name: egl-9 family hypoxia inducible factor 1
pathways: positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: EGLN1 encodes egl nine homolog 1. Annotated molecular activities include 2-oxoglutarate-dependent dioxygenase activity and enzyme inhibitor activity. It participates in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and intracellular oxygen homeostasis.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to EGLN1-related erythrocytosis and pheochromocytoma/paraganglioma predisposition (autosomal dominant); erythrocytosis, familial, 3 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

function.text: EGLN1 encodes egl nine homolog 1. It hydroxylates a specific proline found in each of the oxygen-dependent degradation (ODD) domains (N-terminal, NODD, and C-terminal, CODD) of HIF1A. It has a preference for the CODD site for both HIF1A and HIF1B. Hydroxylated HIFs are then targeted for proteasomal degradation via the von Hippel-Lindau ubiquitination complex.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with EGLN1-related erythrocytosis and pheochromocytoma/paraganglioma predisposition (autosomal dominant); erythrocytosis, familial, 3 (autosomal dominant).
